items.text: Jaxson Dart suffered sprained MCL (initial exams); X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday. Ruled out of MNF, expected to miss some time but generally positive news. Wanted to return.
items.why: Knee injury on big hit throwing; walked off but ruled out; sprained MCL per sources.
items.implication: Giants turn to Jameis Winston short-term; offense limited, impacts Nabers/Skattebo usage and fantasy ceiling.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and short-yardage/run game shifts; monitor Winston snaps.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. Confirmed across primary sources; true GTD resolved to out.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness, missed practices, trending wrong way then confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Davante Adams featured; look to secondary WRs/TEs like Parkinson/Mumpfield for targets in 0-1 Rams offense.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route share for Adams and remaining Rams pass-catchers.

items.text: Dallas Goedert sprained MCL, likely miss a few weeks. Eagles signing Zach Ertz to practice squad with intent to promote.
items.why: Knee injury Sunday vs Titans; MRI confirmed MCL sprain.
items.implication: TE vacuum in Eagles offense; Ertz reunion, Mundt/Jenkins short-term; targets to WRs like DeVonta Smith/Wicks.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining pass-catchers and possible Ertz elevation.

items.text: Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow (again); imaging done, consulting specialists. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle. Daniels out at least Week 3.
items.why: Freak dislocation bracing fall after being stepped on; same elbow as prior; no fracture on X-ray.
items.implication: Mariota starts; Commanders offense efficiency drop, impacts skill players (McLaurin etc) ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Mariota streaming/DFS consideration; handcuff/backup QB value limited.

items.text: Malik Nabers questionable to return (shoulder) mid-MNF then returned to field.
items.why: Shoulder injury during game; cleared to return.
items.implication: Played through; monitor for lingering effects next week amid Dart absence.
items.opportunity: Continued high target share if healthy.

items.text: Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring pull (MRI done); Ben Johnson expects he will likely miss some time. Same hamstring as college injury. Tyson Bagent backup.
items.why: Hamstring injury Sunday vs Vikings; carted; coach confirms miss time.
items.implication: Bears offense without Williams; impacts Odunze/Moore/Loveland etc. Bagent starts potentially.
items.opportunity: Monitor Bagent and Bears skill usage under backup.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12 Bucky. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as lead back in TB; Gainwell diminished role.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share, goal-line potential for Irving; fade Gainwell.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson fumbled again (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble punishment + offense needs explosiveness with Brown out.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion/more touches; Stevenson docked but still involved.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE. Target shares 27%/38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points per model.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points early; Goedert absence may boost further.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 with massive volume in PHI offense.
items.opportunity: High target share, red-zone, two-minute usage.

items.text: Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger; hope it's minor. He played through it.
items.why: Stinger suffered Sunday; played through, MRI for confirmation.
items.implication: Likely minor; monitor practice but not expected long-term. Eagles RB depth thin with other issues.
items.opportunity: If limited, Gainwell or others, but hope full go.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible). RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring). Grab Jonah Coleman if available as Harvey handcuff/beneficiary.
items.why: McConkey improved, optimism from Rap/ETR; Harvey not expected and confirmed inactive.
items.implication: McConkey playable with docks; Harvey out opens RB looks for Coleman/others in DEN.
items.opportunity: McConkey routes/targets if limited; Coleman waiver/handcuff upside.

items.text: Weekend reports: McConkey GTD optimism (flak), Nacua GTD, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow expected, Flowers/Pittman OUT. Postgame watchlist includes Daniels, Williams, Barkley, Goedert, Njoku etc.
items.why: Compiled beat/practice reports and Sunday exits.
items.implication: Key status resolutions and postgame monitoring for Week 3.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUT players (e.g. for Flowers/Pittman); role clarity.

items.text: Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel; will rehab not surgery. Out several weeks, possible midseason return. IR possible.
items.implication: IND WR depth hit; more targets to Downs/Pittman (if healthy)/others.
items.opportunity: Josh Downs and remaining Colts WRs elevated role.

items.text: Quentin Johnston YPRR by year: 2023 0.88, 2024 1.63, 2025 1.44, 2026 0.48 (inconceivably horrific).
items.implication: Hard fade despite opportunities; LAC WR corps inefficiency.
items.opportunity: Low YPRR signals limited fantasy upside even with snaps.
